events.title: Two New Robot Operas in the Circus Tent!
events.summary: Two new operas for the circus tent The robot soprano in the Main Park circus tent has learned two new songs. Grab a seat in front of the stage and enjoy the show! 🌸 Due Cuori A romantic aria about a carriage ride, a wild river and a little squirrel in danger. events.title: Next Fest Demo Update – Easier to explore, more to discover!
events.summary: Hi everyone! Steam Next Fest starts today – and I've updated the demo based on your playtest feedback. What's new New "Discover" checklist: see which attractions are waiting on each island and tick them off as you find them New signposts and a pier gate showing the way to the boat and the islands Shorter, clearer welcome texts in the menu and on the laptop Attractions that are full version only are now clearly marked Arcade hall: the concept games now have their own sign – vote in the Steam disc

events.title: New in Game & Demo: Robot Opera in the Circus Tent! 🎭🤖
events.summary: The big circus tent in the Main Park is open! 🎪 A pirate robot now sings Italian opera live on stage – with light show and video screen. https://youtu.be/BCsgF9gosq4 🆓 Now in the free demo and the full game! ❤️ Please wishlist – as a solo dev, every wishlist helps a lot! Rocky

events.title: New: Treasure Hunter – new game on Pirate Island
events.summary: Treasure Hunter is finished – a new ride for Pirate Island! The idea: I didn't want a ride where you just sit and watch – you should actually do something. So you float through a rocky canyon in a balloon gondola, walk around freely inside it and operate three harpoons. events.title: Arcade Park Islands – Free DEMO on October 12!
events.summary: The free demo of Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames will be available on October 12 at 7 PM CEST / 10 AM PDT.In the demo you get a good overall impression of the islands, and many of the minigames are already playable, but not all of them. The rest will be waiting for you in the full game.I'm also taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26, and a few weeks after the Next Fest, Arcade Park Islands will launch in Early Access.Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the launch

events.title: Update 2: Quest House in Dino and Mainpark
events.summary: ### September Update 2- I am currently working on the demo version for the park.- There is now a zeppelin for a short flight trip over the park.- The new quest house "Jack's Basecamp" in the Dino Park is integrated (quests to follow).- The new quest house "Bruno's" in the Main Park is integrated (quests to follow).- The colored background lighting in the dino area of the Main Park is now in place.- Bug fixes for the menu and music player have been implemented.

events.title: Update: Meet the Fortune Teller! 🔮
events.summary: The Arcade Park has its own Fortune Teller now! Spend 1 ticket and get a fun little prediction about your future. Professor Cogsworth and his little companion are waiting for you.
